leg_cost_allocation: 50/50 assumption; not measured per-leg execution costs

methods.coin_flip: independent fair directions, preserves dates and sizes but not long/short mix or persistence
methods.stratified_shuffle: permute sign within each walk-forward fold and exact size; preserves directional count and vega mix within strata
methods.stratified_circular_shift: rotate sign within each fold/size stratum in chronological order; preserves that stratum's circular direction runs and exact mix, not all cross-stratum dependence

scope: conditional on learned entry selection and size; no retraining; measures direction alignment in this inspected historical sample, not independent evidence of generalizable edge
